about.title: About {store}
about.lead: We make Ayurvedic nutrition for dairy animals, so that every cow, calf and bull on your farm can grow strong, stay healthy and give its best.

story.title: Our story
story.first: {store} began with a simple belief: a healthy herd starts with good nutrition. Minerals and vitamins are only a small part of what an animal eats, but when they run short the whole farm feels it, in lower milk, weaker calves, slower growth and missed breeding.
story.second: So we set out to close those gaps. We blend pure Ayurvedic herbs with the essential macro and micro minerals, vitamins, protein, prebiotics and probiotics that dairy animals need, and pack them into simple supplements that mix straight into daily feed.
story.based: We are based in {city}, {region}, and work with dairy farmers and dealers who want healthier animals and better returns.

ayurveda.title: Rooted in Ayurveda
ayurveda.body: Our formulations are built on pure Ayurvedic herbs, a tradition India's farmers have trusted for generations.

complete.title: Complete nutrition
complete.body: Macro and micro minerals, vitamins, protein, prebiotics and probiotics, all in the right balance.

herd.title: Care for the whole herd
herd.body: The healthy mother gives a healthy calf, and the quality bull makes the quality herd. We make something for each of them.

farmer.title: Better returns for farmers
farmer.body: Feeding a complete supplement all year round is simple, low-cost protection against the problems that cut into a farm's income.

about.rangeAlt: {store} products: PürMin, Calcio Forte, Mintrox and PürVit, for better growth, stronger immunity, higher milk production and overall wellness.

oxellent.coverAlt: Ox'ellent pack beside a strong bull in a green pasture, with its main benefits: natural vitality, reproductive performance, less stress and natural immunity.
oxellent.title: Ox'ellent: power the bull, build a better herd
oxellent.lead: Ox'ellent is an Ayurvedic nutritional supplement made for breeding bulls. It brings natural calcium, dietary fibre, vitamins, minerals, prebiotics and probiotics together to support fertility, strength and everyday health.

why.title: Why bull fertility matters
why.first: In every dairy and breeding herd, the bull's fertility is of paramount importance. One bull sires many calves, so his semen quality, libido and stamina shape the whole herd for years.
why.second: A bull's nutritional status is one of the main things that decides the quality and quantity of his semen. Ox'ellent is made to fill that gap: it helps a bull reach his full fertile potential and improves his reproductive performance.
why.quote: The quality bull makes the quality herd.

oxellent.posterAlt: Ox'ellent poster: Power the Bull, an excellent Ayurvedic formulation for the bull, with a strong cartoon bull inside a ring of green leaves.

benefits.title: What Ox'ellent does
benefits.brain: Good for brain and body betterment
benefits.calf: Helps faster growth of calves and bone formation
benefits.nutrients: Natural source of protein, vitamins and minerals

inside.title: What's inside
inside.lead: An Ayurvedic nutritional supplement with a rich source of:

minerals.title: Why a complete mineral supplement pays off
minerals.first: Minerals make up only a small part of what cattle eat, but they play a big role in how the animal performs. Marginal mineral deficiencies can easily go unnoticed, and they show up later as lower reproductive efficiency, poor growth and weaker immunity.
minerals.second: All of these end up affecting your profit. Giving a complete mineral supplement all year round is cheap insurance against the many problems that mineral deficiencies bring.

oxellent.brochureAlt: Ox'ellent brochure: why bull fertility matters, the full list of benefits, what the supplement contains, and why a complete mineral supplement helps cattle.
oxellent.notice: Ox'ellent is an animal feed supplement. It is not for humans and not for medicinal use. Ask your veterinarian about the right amount for your bull.
